Mira found a red kite beside the old tree. She fixed its string and ran across the field.
The kite rose into the clear sky, and Mira laughed with her friend Sol.
<|endoftext|>
Sol built a tiny boat from paper. The boat crossed a puddle before the rain stopped.
Mira wrote the result in a notebook so they could repeat their small experiment.
